source.comparison_method: Git blob content identity plus SHA-256 comparison against original source bytes, using Git objects for sparse-excluded paths.

engine.version_source: retained engine logs and earlier version check; engine was not executed during verification

tests.count_basis: count of explicit successful ok lines; final marker has no number

existing_test_summary.note: 14 distinct test scripts. Counts come from numeric markers except 24 explicit action-test ok lines. All completion markers were reviewed manually; most checked-runner invocations did not require a text marker.

notes: Each project.godot is intentionally minimal. Generated UID sidecars differ from tracked source metadata in parent and calibration; profiles has one changed .gd.uid and four .svg.import UID fields. These are not byte-identical and were not hidden.

The only differing production .gd source is routing scenery/collision_world.gd, an intentional stub. parent/project/shell_projection.gd is a fixture-only script with 13 verbatim copied methods and inert surrounding objects.

Generated .godot caches, race data, and fixture-only probe scripts are not production dependencies. Matching current fixture files do not prove that no file changed during an earlier run unless separately bound by a contemporaneous manifest.

probe_observation_counts.note: Probe checks assert the adverse observations; these are not passing product-correctness regressions. Counts overlap earlier versions and must not be added to the 845 baseline checks.

hotpath_timing.scope: Exact AppRoot methods with inert app fixtures; no renderer, physics, SDL or USB delivery
hotpath_timing.limitation: Projected selected path with inert fixtures; cache is a prototype without invalidation, not a full app or hardware benchmark.
hotpath_timing.counting_limit: The fixture explicitly counts _controller_bindings and profile_for_device calls; generic_identities is map size, not an instrumented allocation counter.

limitations: No engine or test reruns were performed during this verification.
All inspected runner logs match their report bytes and SHA-256, including failed attempts. Hashes establish integrity relative to the reports, not independent authenticity.
This is targeted synthetic software evidence; it does not establish full-suite, physical-device, SDL/USB, graphical, exported-package, RF-loss, or target-hardware performance qualification.
